items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date is given, so the letter date is the posting day. For tax offices the letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sunday). Because this falls on a Sunday and the sender is a Finanzamt, the delivery day itself moves to the next working day under §108 Abs. 3 AO: Monday 23.11.2026 is the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) date. The one-month Einspruch period of §355 Abs. 1 AO then runs under §§187, 188 BGB: the day of delivery (23.11.) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in MV, so no further shift applies.
